title: Concept: Meta refresh navigates an HTTPS page to a plaintext URL
description: A meta refresh to a plaintext URL walks the user off the protected page without any browser warning. Everything after the refresh — the session cookie if the domain matches, the credentials typed into the next form — travels unprotected.
applicability: HTTPS responses whose HTML carries meta refresh navigation.
risk: A network attacker reads or rewrites everything after the navigation, including credentials entered on the plaintext page, and the downgrade is invisible because the first page was secure.
